summary: 30-ft steel tower on Becket Mountain (Berkshire Co., MA), built c.1913-15, moved to Lair Mountain in Tolland in 1916; footings remain on the Appalachian Trail summit.

facts.design: 30-foot steel tower with a telephone line; a 20-foot extension was added after the move to Lair Mountain
facts.status_note: Tower moved to Lair Mountain in Tolland in 1916; concrete footings remain on the summit.

access.note: Appalachian Trail passes over the summit.

visit.trail_note: The Appalachian Trail climbs to the summit in just over 0.5 mile from the road.

events.note: Willhite gives 1913 (maybe 40 ft); firetower.org says first operated 1915; the 1916 report says in use for three years. Willhite also gives 1914 in one account.
Taken down and moved to Lair Mountain (Lair's Hill) in Tolland, where a 20-foot extension was added.
Firetower.org records the tower removed in 1916.
Massachusetts Geodetic Survey crew noted old fire tower foundations at the summit.
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register as US 44, MA 44 (September 3, 2008).

evidence.supports: Becket Mountain is in Berkshire County, Massachusetts
30-foot steel tower first operated in 1915 with a telephone line
evidence.quote: This 30' steel tower was first operated in 1915 and had a telephone line run to it.

evidence.supports: Site lies along the Appalachian Trail
evidence.quote: This site is located along the Appalachian trail.

evidence.supports: State Forester annual report says the tower had been in use for three years and was moved to Lair's Hill in Tolland
evidence.quote: A 30-foot tower which has been used for the past three years on Becket Mountain in the town of Becket has been taken down and removed to Lair's Hill in Tolland.

evidence.quote: Annual Report of the State Forester

evidence.supports: Willhite: 1913 30-foot steel tower with a telephone line, maybe 40 feet
evidence.quote: In 1913, a 30-foot steel tower was built (maybe 40 feet). This tower had a telephone line to it.

evidence.quote: Beginning at the road, head north on the A.T., climbing to the summit of Becket Mountain in just over 0.5 mile.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Willhite gives 1913 and, in another account, 1914; firetower.org says first operated 1915; the 1916 State Forester report says in use for the past three years. The event is dated 1913 as the earliest source-supported year, with the conflict noted.
firetower.org and the 1916 report say 30 feet; Willhite says 30 feet, maybe 40. The record keeps 9.1 m (30 ft).
The 1916 report calls the new site Lair's Hill; Willhite calls it Lair Mountain. Both place it in Tolland.

notes_for_editor: Brief said access unknown; set to public because the Appalachian Trail passes over the summit. Build year is disputed (1913, 1914, 1915). The Willhite page is a personal trail-lookout site; its footings claims are repeated by the AT hike description, and firetower.org agrees that footings remain. The AT page heading reads 'Hike Description' (checked 2026-10-10), so the source title was changed to match it. Willhite's other account (built 1914, stored, rebuilt on Lair Mountain in 1915) conflicts with the 1916 move; it is noted here and not in the story. No staffing or fire information found.
